result:
I fixed all six sign-in and sign-out problems. The type check passes and the existing test suite passes (617 tests); I didn't add new tests for these cases.

1. **Signing out ends only that session.** Sign-out now deletes just the session tied to that browser's cookie. Before, it ran a clean-up that deleted every session created before that moment. Signing out an unknown or already-ended session does nothing. I also changed that clean-up so it only removes sessions that have actually expired.
2. **Reset links last 60 minutes and work once.** The lifetime was set to 1 minute; it is now 60. A link that has already been used is now refused, including when two attempts arrive at the same moment.
3. **Resetting a password signs out every device on that account.** Other accounts stay signed in.
4. **A new reset link retires the earlier unused ones**, for that account only.
5. **Limits are per address.** Sign-in attempts and reset requests each count per address, ignoring letter case, and the two limits are separate. Opening a reset link isn't limited at all, so an account blocked from signing in can still request and complete a reset. The link contains a long random secret, so it can't practically be guessed.
6. **"Remember me" works.** Without it a session lasts 24 hours; with it, 30 days.

The rate-limit settings still work when the limit is keyed per address, and I added an explicit sign-in limit of 30 attempts, refilling 10 per minute. That is the same as the old default, so the numbers haven't changed.

One side effect: the sign-in and reset form handlers used to charge their own shared "anonymous" limit, which was one cause of everyone being locked out together. I removed those checks because the per-address limit inside the auth service now covers them. As a result, a blocked user sees a plain "too many attempts" message instead of the dedicated rate-limit error. Also, signing up still starts a session, and it now lasts the 24-hour default.

The main changes are in `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`, `src/server/services/session-service.ts`, the session and reset-token repositories, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, and the login and reset-password actions.
